At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

You will join Alma’s central Data team, which supports a wide range of business teams, including Finance, Product, Marketing, Risk, and Operations. The team is made up of six Data Analysts, including several experienced colleagues, and works at the intersection of Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and business teams.

Reporting to Gil Marlard, you will help strengthen the data foundations that support reporting, analytics, operational processes, and business decision-making.

This position is a permanent (CDI) role based in Paris, with a hybrid working model, we are also open to full remote in France.

💼 About the job

As an Analytics Engineer, you will help strengthen the data foundations that support the whole organization. The central Data team serves a wide range of business teams, including Finance, Product, Marketing, Risk, and Operations. You will join a team of six Data Analysts, including several experienced colleagues, and work at the intersection of Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and business teams.

You will transform raw data into trusted datasets that support reporting, analytics, operational processes, such as deciding which customer to call, and business decision-making.

Our data foundations currently have different levels of maturity across business teams, and part of our ambition is to rebuild and standardize some of them. Your work will be particularly important in enabling more self-service and conversational analytics for our business teams, by making data easier to find, understand, trust, and use.

Build and maintain reusable data models, macros, and semantic layers in dbt and BigQuery

Develop staging, intermediate, and mart models following clear data modeling principles

jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?
Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.
Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.
 
Notre vision
Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.
Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.
Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.
 
À propos de Pennylane
Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.
 
En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :
💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant
💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!
🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible
🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours
🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context
Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations.
As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead, you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk.
Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection.
This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house.

Responsibilities
Own end-to-end first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for business customers, ensuring that alert triage, investigations, customer outreach and escalations are completed in line with policies set by Compliance and Risk and within agreed SLAs.

Translate AML/CFT and fraud policies into operational procedures, decision trees and analyst playbooks, and provide evidence-based recommendations on alert quality and operational bottlenecks.

Review complex or high-risk alerts within the first-line mandate, oversee post-onboarding fraud cases and ensure that escalations, customer complaints and law-enforcement requests are handled with complete, auditable records.

Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews.

Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning.

Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs.

Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual.

First 6–12 months
Deliver approved operating procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules before go-live.

Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times.

Validate that alert queues, evidence collection, account measures and second-line handovers work operationally before launch.

By go-live, have first-line monitoring operational for new customers, with trained coverage, agreed SLAs, documented QA controls and named escalation owners.

What we’re looking for
Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions.

Proven experience leading and developing an operational team responsible for alert queues or investigations, combining effective coaching with a hands-on player-coach approach when needed.

Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case.

Good working knowledge of French and European AML/CFT expectations, including ACPR and TRACFIN requirements, and experience translating policy into SOPs, decision trees and analyst guidance.

Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes.

Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate.

Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity.

Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders.

Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving.

Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage.

Languages, presence and location
Fluent French and English are mandatory.

Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join
Build first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for a new regulated entity from the ground up.

Shape the operating model before launch, rather than inheriting fixed processes and tooling.

Take ownership of a critical domain with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer protection and responsible growth.

Work closely with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product and Tech on a strategic company project.

Recruitment Process
1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter
2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager
3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h)
4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)
🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)
🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.
 
Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:
-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)
-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant
-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes
-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.
 
Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.
Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !
 
Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s
Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.
 
Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).
Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .
Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.
Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."
 
Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. This is a high-autonomy, greenfield role at the heart of Pennylane’s future licensed operations.

Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end execution of credit origination, including manual reviews, decisions within the delegated first-line mandate, exception handling and escalation to Risk. Ensure that outcomes meet agreed SLAs and are supported by a complete audit trail.

Build the credit operating model, including procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, first-line controls, operational KPIs and escalation paths.

Own first-line operational monitoring of the active book, including repayment incidents, early-warning signals and the follow-up actions required by the credit policy.

Build the operational relationship with the financing partner, with clear responsibilities, service levels and escalation processes for servicing, disbursement and collection incidents.

Provide Risk with structured feedback on policy effectiveness, operational impact and emerging portfolio signals. Risk remains accountable for risk appetite, policy approval and independent oversight.

Partner with Product, Tech, Risk and Data to design origination workflows, analyst tools and scoring processes, translate operational needs into product requirements, and determine what to automate or retain for human review.

Remain hands-on during the launch phase, then recruit and lead the first credit analysts as volumes grow, establishing clear quality standards and a culture of rigour, accountability and customer clarity.

First 6–12 months
Before the first own-book exposure, deliver an approved end-to-end operating model covering procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, evidence requirements and escalation paths to Risk.

Ensure that the origination workflow is operationally ready for launch by testing the main decision paths and failure scenarios with Product and Tech.

Establish the initial management framework, including SLAs, quality controls, operational KPIs, portfolio-monitoring indicators and reporting to the second-line Risk function.

Ensure that every credit decision can be reconstructed from the underlying data, evidence, applicable policy and recorded approvals.

Define the initial capacity model, team coverage and hiring plan based on expected volumes, handling times and observed performance.

By go-live, have trained operational coverage, named escalation owners and documented procedures for manual reviews, exceptions and partner incidents.

What we’re looking for
Significant experience in credit or underwriting operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including manual reviews, delegated decisions, exceptions and audit trails.

Experience managing operational quality, SLAs and capacity, with direct team leadership or a strong player-coach track record.

Strong understanding of first-line credit operations and the respective responsibilities of Operations and Risk.

Experience collaborating with Product or Tech teams on workflows, tooling and automation.

Ability to use operational and portfolio indicators to identify early-warning signals, manage performance and plan capacity.

Sound judgement on what to automate, what requires human review and when a case should be escalated.

Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions and communicate them clearly to customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

Experience with SME financing products, such as invoice financing or short-term working-capital facilities, would be a strong advantage.

Languages, presence and location
Fluent French and English are mandatory.

Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join
Build the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s future société de financement from the ground up.

Shape the operating model, tooling and team before the own-book financing activity reaches scale.

Take ownership of a critical function with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer experience and responsible growth.

Work closely with Risk, Product, Tech and our financing partner on a strategic company project.

Join a high-autonomy role with compensation that includes equity and reflects the level of responsibility.

jobs.description:
🏨 The Company
Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.
Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.
Our solutions optimise patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in-depth analysis of real-world data.

📝 Your Role
In a nutshell
You will join our engineering team as a Backend & Applied AI Engineer. Your role will focus primarily on a product used to structure real-world clinical data: developing and maintaining product services and APIs, improving performance and architecture, and strengthening production reliability.
You will also contribute to the delivery of AI-enabled features through code review and backend integration. In the short and medium term, the role is expected to be approximately 75% backend and 25% Applied AI. This split may evolve with team and product needs, without a predefined trajectory.

Become progressively autonomous on the product backend during your first six months.

Reduce production blind spots by improving incident detection and follow-through.

Evolve the architecture to better support concurrency, parallelism and processing volumes.

Help the team deliver AI components that are reliable, performant and properly integrated into the product.

Develop and maintain backend services and APIs in Python.

Work with the rest of the team, to deliver product changes end to end.

Measure and improve processing time, scalability and backend architecture.

Strengthen testing, CI/CD, observability and production reliability.

Collaborate with, the Applied AI Engineer, particularly on pull-request reviews and the backend integration of AI-enabled features.

Develop backend services in Python.

Design and evolve APIs.

Work with databases and data-processing workflows.

Use Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines.

Integrate an AI model or LLM API into a product, even through an initial hands-on experience.

Open and direct communication.

A collaborative approach across backend, frontend, product and applied AI.

The drive to learn quickly while asking for support at the right time.

Care for code quality and the operational consequences of technical choices.

Built up to two years of professional experience, through employment or significant projects in Python backend development.

Developed and deployed at least one service or API.

Used a database in a real application.

Worked with Docker and a continuous-integration workflow.

Worked in both French and English, with a minimum B2 level in each language.

It is a plus if you have worked on processing-intensive systems, NLP/LLM pipelines, healthcare data or a production SaaS product.

💛 Why join us?
Build a product that puts data and AI at the service of care and clinical research.

Progressively take real backend ownership with support suited to an early-career role.

Work on concrete performance, architecture and production-reliability challenges.

Collaborate daily with frontend and Applied AI engineers.

Join a team that works remotely from France while maintaining regular links with Paris.

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Manager / Chef.fe de Projet Déploiement Technique
jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.
Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour.
Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, deux choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.
Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer.
Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations
Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.
L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Elle accompagne chaque hôpital dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.
Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un profil à la croisée de la technique et de la gestion de projet : une personne capable de piloter un déploiement client de bout en bout, mais aussi de prendre en main les aspects techniques de l'intégration de nos solutions.
Si tu aimes autant comprendre comment fonctionnent les systèmes informatiques que coordonner les parties prenantes d'un projet, ce poste devrait te plaire !

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous
En tant que Technical Implementation Manager, tu seras responsable de la mise en œuvre technique de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé, depuis le cadrage initial jusqu'à leur mise en production.

Ton rôle ? Faire en sorte que nos solutions s'intègrent correctement dans les systèmes d'information hospitaliers, tout en garantissant le bon déroulement des déploiements.

Concrètement, tu seras amené(e) à :
🔧 Piloter et réaliser les déploiements techniques
Configurer et déployer nos applications dans les environnements informatiques de nos clients.

Mettre en place et configurer les flux d'interopérabilité entre nos solutions et les systèmes d'information hospitaliers (notamment HL7).

Travailler avec les équipes IT des établissements sur les prérequis techniques : serveurs Windows, réseau, connectivité, VPN, SFTP, certificats et sécurité.

Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques rencontrés lors des installations et des mises en production.

📋 Gérer tes projets d'implémentation de bout en bout
Organiser et animer les réunions de cadrage technique avec les établissements de santé.

Identifier les besoins, les contraintes et les prérequis techniques nécessaires au déploiement.

Coordonner les différents interlocuteurs (DSI, équipes techniques hospitalières, chefs de projet, équipes internes Lifen) pour assurer la bonne avancée des projets.

Suivre les différentes étapes du déploiement, anticiper les risques, lever les blocages et garantir la qualité des mises en production.

🔍 Garantir le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions
Réaliser les tests techniques et fonctionnels avec les clients afin de valider le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions de bout en bout.

Analyser les incidents et identifier leur origine (configuration, connectivité, flux, application...).

Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 en collaboration avec les équipes Support, Produit et R&D.

Surveiller les flux et les certificats pour anticiper les dysfonctionnements.

🤝 Être un interlocuteur technique de confiance pour nos clients
Échanger directement avec les équipes IT des hôpitaux pour résoudre les problématiques d'intégration.

Savoir expliquer des sujets techniques à des interlocuteurs moins techniques.

Comprendre les contraintes du terrain pour proposer des solutions adaptées, fiables et pérennes.

🚀 Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos déploiements
Documenter les configurations, les procédures et les problématiques rencontrées.

Identifier des opportunités pour standardiser, automatiser et fiabiliser nos déploiements.

Faire remonter les retours terrain aux équipes Produit et R&D pour contribuer à l'évolution de nos solutions.

Développer progressivement une expertise sur l'ensemble de nos produits.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons
Nous recherchons avant tout un profil technique qui aime gérer des projets, résoudre des problèmes concrets et travailler directement avec les clients.

🖥️ De solides bases techniques
Tu as une expérience pratique dans le déploiement, l'intégration ou l'administration de solutions logicielles et tu es à l'aise avec plusieurs des environnements et technologies suivants :
Systèmes : environnements Windows Server, administration système, GPO, installation et configuration d'applications.

Réseaux et connectivité : TCP/IP, VPN, SFTP, certificats et notions de sécurité informatique.

Intégration applicative : compréhension des échanges de données entre applications, des flux et des problématiques d'interopérabilité.

Diagnostic technique : capacité à analyser des logs, identifier l'origine d'un incident et conduire sa résolution.

Tu n'as pas besoin d'être expert(e) sur chacune de ces technologies, mais tu dois avoir suffisamment de bagage technique pour être autonome face aux problématiques d'un déploiement.

📋 Une expérience en gestion de projet technique
Tu as déjà coordonné des déploiements ou des projets d'intégration de logiciels chez des clients, en collaboration avec plusieurs interlocuteurs techniques et métiers.
Tu sais organiser un projet, suivre ses étapes, anticiper les risques et faire avancer les sujets jusqu'à leur résolution.

🤝 Une vraie aisance dans la relation client
Tu es capable d'échanger aussi bien avec un administrateur système ou un responsable IT qu'avec un chef de projet ou un utilisateur métier.
Tu sais vulgariser les sujets techniques, poser les bonnes questions et construire une relation de confiance avec tes interlocuteurs.

🛠️ Un état d'esprit orienté résolution de problèmes
Tu aimes comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent, investiguer lorsqu'un problème survient et trouver des solutions concrètes.
Tu es autonome, rigoureux(se), proactif(ve) et tu n'hésites pas à mettre les mains dans le cambouis plutôt que de simplement coordonner les actions des autres.

🏥 Une connaissance du secteur de la santé est un plus
Une expérience dans un établissement de santé, chez un éditeur de logiciels de santé ou dans l'intégration de systèmes d'information hospitaliers sera particulièrement appréciée.
Une connaissance des standards d'interopérabilité en santé, notamment HL7, est également un vrai atout.

Mais ce n'est pas indispensable : si tu disposes d'un solide socle technique et d'une expérience en déploiement logiciel, nous pourrons t'accompagner dans la découverte des spécificités du secteur hospitalier.

💎 Nos avantages
Package entre 40-47K€

Mode de travail : Commuter (3 jours/semaine au bureau)

Une carte Swile avec 9 €/jour (50 % Lifen)

Une mutuelle santé incluant médecine alternative et soutien en santé mentale (55 % Lifen)

30 €/mois pour concerts, musées ou même pour rembourser ton abonnement Spotify

Une prise en charge à 100 % du congé maternité et paternité + 5 jours enfants malades par an

1 offsite avec ton équipe par semestre + 1 offsite global Lifen par an + 1 monthly où nous nous retrouvons tous au bureau à Paris

Et enfin : une politique de rémunération transparente et graduelle

👥 Notre process de recrutement
Premier échange RH avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager (30 minutes)

Entretien manager avec Loïc (45 minutes)

Cas pratique technique à préparer chez soi, puis restitution et discussion avec l'équipe dans nos locaux (1 heure)

Entretien final avec deux Lifeners d'une autre équipe

Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. jobs.title: First RevOps
jobs.description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.
We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.
Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.
We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.
 
The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !
Context
Our coding agent is live in 70 hospitals across France. In March, we raised $20M from Index Ventures to push it further and build what comes next: billing, admissions, patient records.
The next six months are going to move fast. We'll double to +60 people, open Germany, and triple the size of our Revenue team. Today, too much of how we run the company still depends on manual work and tools that don't talk to each other.
Nobody owns this problem yet, it will be yours.

Your mission
Make sure Parallel can double without drowning in manual work.
Attio, our CRM, will be your main tool, and you'll run it end to end. You'll also sit with each team, see what they still do by hand, and automate it yourself. On top of that, you'll work on Sales, Marketing and Finance Ops topics, like billing, cash tracking and commissions.
You'll report to Clem, our Ops Lead, and work every day with the founders and the go-to-market teams. You build things, you don't write decks about them. There's no team to manage at first, but the function is yours to shape, and we assume it will grow.

What you'll do
Own Attio, end to end
Administer and configure Attio: data model, pipelines, fields, views, access rights and workflows

Enrich our CRM with data valuable for Sales, Ops and Finance teams, so that it can be the source of truth while scaling

Connect Attio to the rest of our stack so processes run without manual steps

Support users and turn their pain points into better configurations

Automate our internal work, with AI where it makes sense
Map repetitive tasks across Sales, Marketing, Ops and Finance, and prioritize them by impact and effort

Build automations, integrations and AI use cases yourself, with no-code or low-code tools, and APIs when needed

Pick a simple rule or AI depending on the need, test on real cases, and keep a human in the loop when it matters

Protect sensitive data, control access, and measure time saved, errors and costs

Make Sales and Ops steering reliable
Help define the priority metrics and agree on shared definitions

Run the analyses, SQL queries and dashboards yourself

Automate data collection and updates to kill manual reporting

Build processes that hold as we double
Document the rules, owners, limits of AI use and what to do when something breaks

Structure the handoffs between teams, train users and check real adoption in the field

Outcomes
You ship from week one: automations are expected in your first month, not in six.
Month 1: diagnose and ship a first win
You run Attio autonomously, have audited its configuration and data, and shipped the first improvements teams feel

A prioritized list of automation and AI opportunities, and a 90-day plan validated with Clem

Your first automation is live, tested with its users, with a baseline measured to track the gain

Month 2: deploy and measure
Several automations are used by the teams, with time saved and output quality tracked on real cases

Priority metrics are live and tested with the teams

Month 3: stabilize and drive adoption
Several automations run in production, used regularly, with error monitoring and a clear maintenance owner

Attio and our data are reliable enough for the priority processes, and shared metrics are used to make decisions

Users are trained, and your 6-month extension plan is validated with Clem

Month 6: scale what works
The solutions that work are extended, documented and monitored

The key handoffs between teams are structured and adopted, keeping pace as we grow to around 60 people and open Germany

You are
The non-negotiable
You have run a CRM yourself, not just used it. You have administered, configured and optimized one personally: data model, pipelines, permissions, workflows, integrations. Attio experience is a plus; if you come from another CRM, you can show you will master Attio fast. Strong automation or AI skills won't make up for this one

Also essential
3-5 years of RevOps, SalesOps or BizOps experience in a B2B startup, with business automations you built and shipped yourself

Real use of AI applied to internal work, and the judgment to know when a simple rule does the job better

At ease with data: you write SQL, run your own analyses and build dashboards; you ship a working v1 fast, then improve it

Autonomous and pragmatic: you don't wait for a detailed spec, you go after the high-impact problems and deliver simple, usable solutions

Rigorous: you check your work, set up controls and document so processes are reproducible

You explain technical topics simply to business teams, and get them to agree on rules and actually adopt them

Nice to have
A solid understanding of how a SaaS business works, from sales cycle to operations to billing

And you share our values
Play to Win: you set ambitious, measurable goals and own the result

High Trust, High Standards: you keep your commitments, raise risks early and hold a high quality bar

Low Ego, Hands-On: you take feedback, change course when facts say so, and do the unglamorous work yourself

Win as One Team: you put the collective goal ahead of your own scope

Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: you own your mistakes and keep perspective when things get tense

Hiring process
First call with Wallerand: our values, your background, and a first look at your CRM and automation experience

Interview with Clem, Ops Lead: your future manager, deep dive into how you build and run a CRM and your automations

Case study at our Paris office with Paul (CEO) and Clem: you structure and configure a CRM, then automate a process, from framing to a working prototype

Founder interview with Paul

Reference checks, with your consent

Offer

Why should you join us?
AI with real-world impact. Our agents free hospital teams from paperwork, in a system where 70% of French hospitals are in deficit

A function to build from scratch. You are our first RevOps: the stack, the processes and how we use AI internally are yours to design

The right moment. A $20M Series A closed in March 2026, the team doubling to around 60 people, Germany opening, and everything still to build

An AI-native company that practices what it sells. We automate hospitals; you get to automate Parallel

Top-tier backers and founders. Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, the CEO of Mistral AI; founders from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo

Direct line to the founders. You work daily with Paul and the founding team, and your work shapes how the company scales

Mission principale
Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.
 
PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température
• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.
• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.
• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).
• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.
• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.
• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.
 
Étude et déploiement des matériels
• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.
• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.
• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.
• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.
• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.
• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.
• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.
 
Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation
• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.
• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.
• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.
• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).
• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.
• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.
 
Gestion des fournisseurs
• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.
• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.
• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.
• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.
 
Qualité et amélioration continue
• Participer aux audits internes et externes.
• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.
• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.
• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.
• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.
• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).
 
ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES
Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :
• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;
• valider les choix techniques des installations ;
• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;
• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;
• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.
• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.
 
RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES
En interne
• Direction des Opérations
• Responsable Parc Automobile
• Responsable Exploitation
• Service Qualité
• Conducteurs
• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).
En externe
• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques
• Prestataires de métrologie
• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 PROFIL RECHERCHE
Formation
• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.
Expérience
• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.
• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.
Compétences techniques
• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.
• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.
• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-
140 / COFRAC).
• Analyse de données de température.
• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.
Qualités personnelles
• Sens de l'organisation.
• Rigueur et méthode.
• Esprit d'analyse.
• Capacité de prise de décision.
• Aisance relationnelle.
• Force de proposition.
• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.
• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.
Objectifs du poste
• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.
• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.
• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

Concevoir et développer des solutions et outils d’automatisation en Python, notamment pour les activités de développement, de tests, de validation et de maintenance logicielle.

Une solide connaissance des cycles PDLC/SDLC, des méthodologies Agile, des pratiques DevOps, CI/CD et des principes de qualité logicielle.

Une expérience de mise en œuvre de solutions AI-assisted Software Development, notamment pour la génération de code, les tests automatisés ou l'amélioration des pratiques DevSecOps.

jobs.description:
About HappyRobot
HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.
Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.
This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.
Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.
This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.

Tech Profile
Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
experiment and iterate.

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
cause of issues.

Must Have
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
tight deadlines.

Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
propose solutions.

Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
action.

Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?
Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership
We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.
 
Craftsmanship
Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.
 
We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.
 
Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.
 
Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.
 
First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You Will Join 

You'll be part of our Executive Assistant team led by Claire, Executive Assistant to the CEO. The team consists of 3 Executive Assistants supporting Mirakl's most senior C-levels. Together, you'll ensure seamless operational support that empowers our executive team to focus on Mirakl's growth and strategic impact.

The team works closely together to share best practices, continuously improve processes, and drive efficiency initiatives — including through the use of AI tools.

What You"ll Do

Executive Support — Labs Leadership Team (CTO and Chief Data & AI Officer)

Coordinate and proactively manage executive business calendars (anticipate conflicts, prioritise competing demands, proactively optimize agenda with enough buffers)

Arrange travel end-to-end — flights, hotels, ground transport, visas — and ensure all logistics are in place well in advance of each trip

Prepare and process expense reports for executives when requested, in line with internal policies

Type, revise, edit Linkedin communications

Handle sensitive and confidential information with absolute discretion

Labs Team Support

Arrange and coordinate team meetings

Manage and coordinate specific projects in support of the labs teams, for example: client visits in Mirakl HQ in Paris, team building lunches

Aid in purchase management: raise purchase orders, track invoices, and liaise with Finance to ensure timely processing

Liaise with HR, Finance, and IT on behalf of both departments for any operational or administrative requests (Lucca, TravelPerk, Expensya)

Event Planning & Management

Own end-to-end logistics for a wide range of events : internal Labs Kick-Offs, QBRs, Mirakl Makers Club, team building activities

Ensure all logistics associated with travel, offsite meetings, and events are fully in place well ahead of each date

Source and negotiate with venues, caterers, AV suppliers, and other vendors; manage event budgets and track spend

Manage attendee registration, invitations, RSVPs, and on-site check-in processes

Coordinate speaker and VIP logistics: preparation materials, rehearsals, and on-site support

What You'll Bring

Experience

3–5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, ideally within a fast-growing, international organisation

Proven track record in event planning and management, from intimate team offsites to large-scale conferences

Hands-on experience with expense and purchase management platforms (e.g. Payflows, Expensya)

Skills

Highly organised, with the ability to juggle multiple workstreams and rapidly shifting priorities without losing composure

Proactive and solutions-oriented — you anticipate needs before they become problems

Impeccable discretion when handling sensitive business and personnel information

Genuine curiosity for AI tools, with a drive to leverage them in your day-to-day work

Strong collaborative mindset — a true team player who elevates those around them

Tools Used

Google Suite

Slack

Confluence

TravelPerk

Expensya / Lucca

Dust

Languages

French: Fluent (C2 level required)

English: Fluent (B2 level required)

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity 

Grafana Labs is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, Growth based in France who will be responsible for prospecting and growing existing business across France. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with existing customers. You will manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking about our products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Identify new opportunities to expand Grafana usage within a set of current customers

Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals

Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, negotiations and account management)

Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads

Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise

Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce

Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests

What Makes You a Great Fit:

5+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales

Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)

Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player

Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies

You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually

Fluent in English & French (both spoken & written). 

 Bonus Points For: 

Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage

Experience using Salesforce

Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal

Compensation & Reward 

In France, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 195,750 - EUR 239,500. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 

Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Why join Dataiku? 

Dataiku’s on-premise, cloud, or SaaS-deployed platform connects many data science technologies, and our technology stack reflects our commitment to quality and innovation. We integrate the best of data and AI tech, selecting tools that truly enhance our product. From the latest LLMs to our dedication to open source communities, you'll work with a dynamic range of technologies and contribute to the collective knowledge of global tech innovators. Here are some useful links so you preview what we do at Dataiku: Dataiku's Key Capabilities ; Dataiku's Github, you can also take a look at the Gallery, a public instance showcasing some example projects (note editing is very limited and will be regularly reset). 

Our product is called Dataiku DSS which stands for Dataiku Data Science Studio. If you’d like to know more about it, you can watch the demo here or try the free version here.

How you’ll make an impact 

At DKU, we have multiple engineering teams focusing on various aspects of the software, including AI/ML, MLOps, Data Preparation, Data Visualization, and Cloud Platform. Each team offers internship opportunities where you'll work on specific features with direct impact on the final product. During the interview process, you'll receive detailed information about the available features and their contribution to the overall project.

As an intern, you will be working with more senior software engineers every day on a potential future feature of our product. With guidance and support, you will be able to code, debug, optimize, and document your work while learning how to deliver qualitative work.

The stack may differ from one internship to another, but the global stack of Dataiku is Python/Java for the backend and Angular/Vue/React for the frontend.

Here are some examples of previous projects our interns worked on:

Unsupervised models:

Improve the tooling available for data scientists to train unsupervised (clustering) models in Dataiku

If time allows, extend further to optimize the training and inference of those types of models

Webapp vibe coding:

Build an intelligent “vibe coding” assistant that interprets a user’s intent and aesthetic preferences to automatically generate functional web app code

Prototype and refine techniques that translate natural-language descriptions into usable web components, accelerating web app development for users without deep front-end expertise

Dynamic model management:

Improve management of AI models accessible on already-deployed software to unlock new capabilities without upgrading

Leverage Dataiku’s LLM Mesh and accelerate customer adoption, helping shape Dataiku’s strategy for agentic AI in the enterprise

AI-powered code generation:

Develop and integrate more low-setup code completion features into Dataiku's embedded code editors

As a time-permitting extension, investigate and potentially implement more AI-powered code generation capabilities to further enhance the coding experience

Flow Search: 

Significantly enhance the search and filtering capabilities for Dataiku's complex data pipelines by introducing advanced operators

Implement this powerful search feature by defining a formal query grammar, building an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) to parse user input, and developing a user-friendly interface with live autocompletion and intelligent error feedback

Internationalization: 

Actively contribute to the internationalization of the Dataiku platform by allowing faster translation of new and existing software components into various languages beyond English

Improve and optimize the entire internationalization workflow by implementing technical solutions such as lazy loading for resources, automating translations with LLMs, and developing tools for automated error detection

Files Processor:

Develop a versatile, all-in-one file processing tool within Dataiku to perform a wide range of transformations and filtering on unstructured data, such as resizing images, converting documents (e.g., DOCX to PDF), and more

Streamline data preparation workflows by embedding these file manipulation capabilities directly into Dataiku pipelines, improving user efficiency and reducing the need for external tools

Geo-Grouping:

Develop and implement a new geospatial transformation tool within the Dataiku platform to compute the convex hull of sets of geometric shapes (points and polygons)

Enhance Dataiku's capabilities by enabling customers to geo-group their data, unlocking advanced spatial analytics for use cases in fields like retail and logistics

Cloud Engineering:

Contribute to the launchpad SaaS portal of Dataiku, building full-stack features and leveraging Kubernetes to deliver scalable, secure instance management for companies

Improve platform reliability and developer confidence by implementing safe rollouts (feature flags), deep observability (tracing, metrics, dashboards), and broader automated test coverage

Initial call with a member of our technical recruiting team (30 min) with a presentation of various internship subjects

Technical assessment to show your skills (take-home test)

Discussion with the technical recruiter to select the internship topic (15-30 min) 

Video call with your future manager (1h)

50% reimbursement on Navigo Transport pass and up to 5 paid leaves

Free breakfasts, snacks, and drinks in our office every day and access to the office canteen

Opportunities to work with a unique mix of talents and fast career opportunities

A great place to learn: you will master the key skills of the tech world

Be part of the AI revolution and learn how we support our customers

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. jobs.description:
Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.

High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.

High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.

Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.

Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.

Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.

Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.

Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.

Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.

Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.

Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.

You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.

You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.

You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.

You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have

Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms

Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design

Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents

A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day

Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams

Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal

Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions

Clear, structured documentation habits

Fluent English and French skills

Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus

Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)

Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations

Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects

Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms

SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter

Customer satisfaction with your contribution

Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents

Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern

Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.

Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.

Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.

Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You’ll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.

Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.

Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you’ll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.

Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.

Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.

Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.

Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it’s about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.
